dz: 罗斯基尔德条约:在北方战争(1655–1661)中惨败后,丹麦国王弗雷德里克三世- 挪威被迫将他近一半的领土让给瑞典.
de: Treaty of Roskilde: After a devastating defeat in the Northern Wars (1655–1661), Frederick III, the King of Denmark–Norway is forced to give up nearly half his territory to Sweden.

te: Decisive battle in the struggle for the throne during the Mughal war of succession (1658–1659).
dz: 萨穆加尔战役:莫卧儿继承战争(1658–1659年)中争夺王位的决定性战役.

te: Pope Alexander VII appoints François de Laval vicar apostolic in New France.
dz: 教宗亚历山大七世在新法兰西任命弗朗索瓦·德·拉瓦尔·维卡尔为枢机.

te: Turenne and the French army win a decisive victory over the Spanish at the battle of the Dunes.
dz: 法国-西班牙战争:图伦内和法国军队在德涅斯战役中战胜了西班牙人,取得了决定性的胜利.
de: Franco-Spanish War: Turenne and the French army win a decisive victory over the Spanish at the battle of the Dunes.

dz: 在英西战争中,西班牙军队未能在里约新埃沃战役中收复牙买加.

dz: Abaza Hasan Pasha及其盟友宣布反抗大维齐尔·克普吕尔·迈赫梅德帕夏,要求处决他并进军伊斯坦布尔.
de: Abaza Hasan Pasha and his allies declare a revolt against grand vizier Köprülü Mehmed Pasha, demanding his execution and marching on Istanbul.

te: Aurangzeb is proclaimed Mughal emperor of India.
dz: Aurangzeb被宣布为印度莫卧儿皇帝.
de: Aurangzeb is proclaimed Mughal emperor of India.

de: The Battle of Vilanova is fought between Portugal and Spain during the Portuguese Restoration War.

t: 荷兰共和国海军在"声音之战"中击败了瑞典人.
te: Naval forces of the Dutch Republic defeat the Swedes in the Battle of the Sound.
dz: 第二次北方战争:荷兰共和国海军在"声音之战"中击败了瑞典人.
